rules.text: On offense, a 3rd-or-4th-and-short (distance ≤ 2) or any goal-line short-yardage snap must not be a deep shot. Deep means cfb_coach.madden.catalog.is_deep (vert, flood, shot, seam, fade, and the other tokens that classifier already uses). Example: no deep shot on 3rd-and-1 or goal-line short yardage.

On offense, a two-minute snap while trailing big (margin ≤ -14) must be clock-aware: the call fails when catalog.is_run is true or the play name is a kneel, victory, spike, or take-a-knee. A non-run passes. The rule does not run when score or clock was default-filled.

On offense, while trailing big inside the two-minute window or the 4-min protect window, the call fails when the play name is a kneel, victory, spike, or take-a-knee. A normal run is not this rule; the two-minute rule covers clock-killing runs. Default-filled score or clock does not trigger it.

On defense, goal-line short yardage (distance ≤ 2) must not be a Dime formation. The installed heavier packages are 4-3 Over and the Nickel formations. Dime 3-2 Odd fails. This follows the existing note that goal line and true short yardage keep the heavy package.

On defense, while trailing big in the two-minute or 4-min protect window, a play named prevent or hail mary fails. Cover 4 Quarters is not this rule. Default-filled score or clock does not trigger it. The installed book has no prevent or hail-mary play name, so an in-book call passes and an invented name fails.

run.adapter_resolution: Git merges of PR 55 and PR 56 had no conflicts. eval_scoring.evaluate passes the situation dict into adapt_run_situation. eval_harness.run_situation parses a situation line, and its look normalizer stringifies a mapping, so NULL and empty would not stay distinct.
